notes.topcoded: ACS medians in the open-ended top interval are published as the interval edge (gross rent 3,501 = $3,500+, home value 2,000,001 = $2,000,000+). They are used as-is and flagged *-topcoded.
notes.na: A missing ACS median (insufficient sample) is null and flagged *-na; areas missing the value a calculation needs are left out of that calculation.
